newsitem.title: GREECE: Albanian dies in shootout with Greek coastguard.
newsitem.headline: Albanian dies in shootout with Greek coastguard.

text.p: An Albanian trying to smuggle hashish into Greece was killed on Saturday during a shootout with the Greek coastguard near the Greek-Albanian border, police said.
They said two Albanians unloaded 400 kg of hashish from a speeboat near the Greek port of Igoumenitsa and opened fire at a coastguard patrol which tried to arrest them.

One man was killed and the other was arrested in the latest of a series of drug-related shootouts between Greek forces in Igoumenitsa and the holiday island of Corfu, and drug dealers operating freely in laweless southern Albania.
In a related incident, police said they confiscated a container at the main port of Piraeus with four tonnes of marijuana.
The said the container had arrived on a ship from Cambodia on April 19. It was never claimed and that their prime suspects was a Cypriot living in Belgium and two Greek customs employees.
